ideas.pitch: A platform that calculates the real-time carbon reduction and financial cost savings of enterprise supply chain decisions to prove the ROI of sustainability.
ideas.title: EcoAudit ROI: Smart Green Supply Chain Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly matches the central theme of Measuring ROI & Impact of Emerging Technologies by balancing environmental sustainability with tangible financial metrics that enterprise judges love.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered monitoring web app that ingests IoT sensor data to forecast local pollution spikes and quantifies the economic healthcare cost savings for municipal policymakers.
ideas.title: AeroMetric AI: Urban Air Quality & Economic Impact Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines predictive machine learning with clear, measurable impact metrics, following the pattern of successful real-world impact and forecasting winners.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight analytics service that tracks enterprise cloud workload execution schedules and shifts non-urgent compute jobs to times when local grid carbon intensity is lowest.
ideas.title: GridTrace: Carbon-Aware Enterprise Cloud Compute Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses enterprise digital transformation and sustainability simultaneously, providing a quantified reduction in cloud emissions and utility overhead.

ideas.pitch: An emergency response GIS dashboard that calculates optimal evacuation resource allocation and estimates loss prevention ROI for local disaster management authorities.
ideas.title: DisasterResilience ROI Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on proven disaster management and satellite monitoring hackathon wins by adding a rigorous economic loss-prevention calculation for evaluation juries.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision prototype utilizing a lightweight object detection model to classify e-waste components on a conveyor belt feed, calculating material recovery ROI for recycling plants.
ideas.title: SmartWaste Vision: Automated E-Waste Sorting Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes a working hardware-simulation and computer vision demo that consistently catches judges' attention due to its tangible, physical application to automation.
